ash: Night cut scheduled for 2026-03-28 00:30 UTC. We'll run a cold-start canary on the prod-inference pool. Need final SLA sanity check, pin list, and rollback thresholds. Quiet window 00:20-01:20 UTC. Anyone object?

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Canary created: cny-3059; routing: 1% -> release=2026-03-28-01; command: `/canary start cny-3059 --traffic 1%`

morgan: Oncall — confirm SLA targets: p95 < 500ms, abort if 5xx > 0.5%?

sre-oncall: Confirmed. SLA: 99.95% uptime. Abort criteria: 5xx rate > 0.5% over a 5m window OR p95 > 600ms for 3 consecutive 1m windows. Also watch cold-start tail > 2s for KV-heavy flows.

jules: Quick staging note: smoke tests green. KV-cache warmup script run `scripts/warmup_kv.sh` — first-token ~2.6s, steady-state 50-70ms.

samira: Pin list for rollout: inference-service:v2026-03-28-01, model: llama2-13b-q4_v2, quant profile: act-order-8bit. I'll apply pin after canary passes: `/deploy pin release=2026-03-28-01`

ash: Ash typo — meant to ping folks for a short release blurb. Draft: "Cold-start improvements; KV prefetch; quant tuning for servo latency." Good?

morgan: I'll post the release notes and update changelog once pins are applied.

deploy-bot: Canary traffic bumped to 5% (cny-3059). metrics snapshot: success_rate=99.92% p50=90ms p95=320ms p99=1.4s. No elevated 5xx so far.

sre-oncall: Within bounds. Proceed to 15% then 50% if stable. I'll monitor APM and error dashboards.

ash: Rollback playbook: immediate pin to previous release `v2026-03-20-09` + traffic shift to fallback region `eu-west-2` if abort triggers. Whoever sees alert -> run `/rollback cny-3059 reason=alerts` and ping `@sre-oncall`.

jules: Re-run smoke after 50% traffic and validate cold-start latency on long-context traces.

samira: :thumbsup: finalizing pin ops and will paste changelog link here when done.

morgan: Changelog posted: https://redwood.internal/changelogs/2026-03-28-coldstart-enhancements

ash: Thanks all. Leaving this thread open until 01:40 UTC for post-launch notes and any hotfix decisions."
